info.description:
Auto-generated from routes/api.php. 546 requests across 39 folders.

## Setup
1. Set the `base_url` collection variable (default `http://127.0.0.1:8000/api`).
2. Run **Auth > POST Login** — the token is captured automatically into `{{token}}`.
3. Every other request inherits Bearer `{{token}}` auth from the collection.

## Notes
- `branch_id` is auto-appended by the SPA on GETs; add `?branch_id={{branch_id}}` manually where you need branch scoping.
- Requests marked *(multipart)* use form-data — attach files via the Body tab.
- Path params (`:id`, `:customer`, ...) are exposed as URL variables (default `1`); edit per request.
- JSON bodies are sample stubs — adjust field values to your tenant's data.
